mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, outbox_id, status, attempt_count, locked_by, correlation_id, lock_version FROM outbox_event WHERE contract_ref IN (#{establishedContract}, #{finalizedContract}) AND contract_version = 1 AND aggregate_type = 'WORKFLOW_INSTANCE' AND attempt_count <= #{maxAttempts} AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'PUBLISHING' AND locked_at <= #{leaseCutoff})) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN next_attempt_at ELSE locked_at END, tenant_id, outbox_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PUBLISHING', attempt_count=attempt_count+1, locked_by=#{token}, locked_at=#{now}, lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now}, updated_by_type='SERVICE', updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{candidateTenantId} AND outbox_id=#{candidateOutboxId} AND status='PENDING' AND attempt_count=#{candidateAttemptCount} AND attempt_count<#{maxAttempts} AND lock_version=#{candidateLockVersion} AND next_attempt_at<=#{now}

UPDATE outbox_event SET attempt_count=attempt_count+1, locked_by=#{token}, locked_at=#{now}, lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now}, updated_by_type='SERVICE', updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{candidateTenantId} AND outbox_id=#{candidateOutboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{candidateAttemptCount} AND attempt_count<#{maxAttempts} AND locked_by=#{candidateLockedBy} AND lock_version=#{candidateLockVersion} AND locked_at<=#{leaseCutoff}

UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PUBLISHING', locked_by=#{token}, locked_at=#{now}, lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now}, updated_by_type='SERVICE' WHERE tenant_id=#{candidateTenantId} AND outbox_id=#{candidateOutboxId} AND status='PENDING' AND attempt_count=#{maxAttempts} AND lock_version=#{candidateLockVersion} AND next_attempt_at<=#{now}

UPDATE outbox_event SET locked_by=#{token}, locked_at=#{now}, lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now}, updated_by_type='SERVICE' WHERE tenant_id=#{candidateTenantId} AND outbox_id=#{candidateOutboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{maxAttempts} AND locked_by=#{candidateLockedBy} AND lock_version=#{candidateLockVersion} AND locked_at<=#{leaseCutoff}

UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PUBLISHED', locked_by=NULL, locked_at=NULL, last_error_code=NULL, broker_confirmed_at=#{now}, lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now}, updated_by_type='SERVICE', updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{rowTenantId} AND outbox_id=#{rowOutboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{rowAttemptCount} AND locked_by=#{rowClaimToken} AND lock_version=#{rowLockVersion} AND locked_at>#{leaseCutoff}

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='RESOLVED', resolved_at=#{now}, next_attempt_at=NULL, lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now}, updated_by_type='SERVICE', updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{rowTenantId} AND direction='OUTBOX' AND source_record_id=#{rowOutboxId} AND state='REPLAYING'

UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PENDING', next_attempt_at=#{next}, locked_by=NULL, locked_at=NULL, last_error_code=#{errorCode}, broker_confirmed_at=NULL, lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now}, updated_by_type='SERVICE', updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{rowTenantId} AND outbox_id=#{rowOutboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{rowAttemptCount} AND locked_by=#{rowClaimToken} AND lock_version=#{rowLockVersion} AND locked_at>#{leaseCutoff}

UPDATE outbox_event SET status='RECOVERY_REQUIRED', next_attempt_at=#{now}, locked_by=NULL, locked_at=NULL, last_error_code=#{errorCode}, broker_confirmed_at=NULL, lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now}, updated_by_type='SERVICE', updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{rowTenantId} AND outbox_id=#{rowOutboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{maxAttempts} AND locked_by=#{rowClaimToken} AND lock_version=#{rowLockVersion} AND locked_at>#{leaseCutoff}
mapper.select: SELECT business_intent_key,state FROM message_recovery WHERE tenant_id=#{rowTenantId} AND direction='OUTBOX' AND source_record_id=#{rowOutboxId}

SELECT tenant_id,outbox_id,message_id,publication_key,business_intent_key, aggregate_type,aggregate_id,contract_ref,contract_version,body_bytes, body_sha256,correlation_id,causation_id,attempt_count,locked_by, locked_at,lock_version,created_at FROM outbox_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{attempt} AND locked_by=#{token} AND lock_version=#{lockVersion}
